relationships.subject: CCL2
relationships.evidence_quote: CCL2 acts on CCR2 in ACC excitatory neurons and participates in the regulation of CFA-induced pain and related anxiety-like behaviors through upregulation of NR2B.

relationships.subject: RS504393
relationships.evidence_quote: the CCR2 inhibitor RS504393 reduced the frequency of miniature excitatory postsynaptic currents (mEPSC) in ACC

relationships.subject: Ro 25-6981
relationships.evidence_quote: local injection of the NR2B inhibitor of NMDAR subunits, Ro 25-6981, attenuated the effects of CCL2-induced hyperalgesia and anxiety-like behavior in the ACC

key_findings: CCL2 and CCR2 are upregulated in ACC after CFA; CCR2 is mainly in excitatory neurons.
CCR2 antagonism in ACC reduces CFA pain and anxiety; NR2B inhibition blocks CCL2-induced hyperalgesia.
